coverage_notes.excluded_categories: Donation drives, resource directories, recipes, opinion, routine promotions/distributions, inflation stories, historical 2025 SNAP shutdown material, already logged incidents, prospective non-immediate rules and international events.
coverage_notes.assessment: No new source-backed qualifying U.S. food-access disruption found within 2026-11-10 07:43:57–08:49 PST. Two federal USDA direct endpoints inaccessible while other state/provider/source coverage remained usable. Degradation is recurring and nonmaterial to the bounded recall, not nationwide clearance.
